entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 1487434040320076800: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 71075: distance 26.61 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.004), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 26.61 +/- 0.106 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 37.9125 +/- 0.2550 mas (same row, RUWE 2.59), 148.7 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -114.344, 151.788 mas/yr. Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 1487434040320076800 (quality B), from 2006AstL...32..759G; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 3.109 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 71075: radius 3.109 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 32.029 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.067) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 7793 +/- 286 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 71075: effective temperature 7793 +/- 286 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.047).
